shared_qualifications: PDF p.3 Table II separates plain and neoprene-ring crevice tests. Only the plain series is identifiable in CRA: Nos.253–271 explicitly name the plain column; Nos.69–87 reproduce the same complete plain series. Two CRA IDs linked to one observation represent duplicate database presentations, not two independent paper experiments.

PDF p.2: aerated 0.6 M NaCl + 0.1 M NaHCO3; 120-grit finish, 5 cm², SCE, 5 min at −1.5 V then rapid rise to −0.5 V and 1 V per 50 min. C1: 1000/(50×60)=0.333333333 mV/s. Breakdown criterion 10^−5 A/cm². Authors caution about coating-edge initiation and scatter for plain specimens.
Paper does not give numerical pH for these tests or securely specify electrochemical test temperature. CRA pH 7.68/8.3 and the first series temperature 25°C are not paper-verified identity evidence.

Steel 6: Table I Cr=16.66 wt%; CRA No.74 says 16.86, while No.258 says 16.66. Steel 19: Table I N=.455 wt% versus Table II .435 wt%; Nos.87/271 use .455. Retain source and CRA conflicts; potential agreement remains exact.
